feedback.problem:
What is the exact value of $\operatorname{sin}⁡(-{105}^{∘})?$

*Hint: Use the fact that $-{105}^{∘}={30}^{∘}-{135}^{∘}.$*
feedback.worked_solution:
Recall the difference formula for sine:

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡(x-y)=\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡y-\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡y
$$

Applying the difference formula for sine with $x={30}^{∘}$ and $y={135}^{∘},$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡(-{105}^{∘}) & =\operatorname{sin}⁡({30}^{∘}-{135}^{∘}) \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡{30}^{∘}\operatorname{cos}⁡{135}^{∘}-\operatorname{cos}⁡{30}^{∘}\operatorname{sin}⁡{135}^{∘} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2})-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}-\frac{\sqrt{6}}{4} \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{6}}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
